title: What should I google...
author: Den_er_da_hvid
selftext:
I want to follow some game engines that uses generative AI to make the actual game. A Text-to-game thingy, but my english is not so good so I do not know what are good words to google on yahoo.  
Mostly I get results about making an AI/NPC inside the games and not AI aided development. 

So far I know that Gdevelop has a simple text-to-game prompt to help start a project.

I have also found Rosebud and RiseAngle, I think is more of what I am looking for.  
I know unity is working on something, but there is not much out about the project.
